purpose: Turn response-opaque shared species names, candidate target island counts and spatial block count into an auditable external validation GO/HOLD decision before field incidence cells are opened.

stop_rule.stop_reason: Only 3 eligible original heldout target islands in one spatial block, zero verified island-code pairs. Even hypothetically complete 5-taxon overlap yields at most 15 comparable positive/negative binary cells, insufficient for spatially independent evaluation.

next_principled_biological_system: A survey in a region with independent marine-island observed mammal taxa overlapping 529, at least two eligible distinct original heldout geographic blocks, exact one-to-one island IDs, and standardized detection denominators; ideally several separate archipelagos and observed movements/turnover.
